reading.title: Square Moon, Slow Shifts
overview: The Sun at 25° Libra in fall squares the Moon at 25° Capricorn in detriment and out of bounds, forming a near-exact aspect. Mercury stands at 19° Scorpio, Venus at 4° Scorpio retrograde in detriment, Mars at 12° Leo, Jupiter at 23° Leo, Saturn at 10° Aries retrograde in fall, Uranus at 5° Gemini retrograde, Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde, Pluto at 3° Aquarius in fall stationing retrograde and out of bounds, with the North Node at 27° Aquarius. The Moon is not void and next aspects the Sun by square.

Mundane tradition reads the Sun-Moon square as tension between authority and public mood, while Pluto's station and out-of-bounds condition point to abrupt shifts in collective power structures. Neptune sextile Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto suggest gradual changes in shared beliefs and upheaval, with Saturn conjunct Neptune indicating eroding institutions. The last new moon at Libra 17° falls in the 11th house for the United States, the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, the 4th for China and Taiwan, and the 3rd for North Korea.

Transits within 2° include Neptune opposition the United States MC, Mars trine its ASC, Neptune square its Venus and Sun square its Mercury. Russia sees Neptune square its Sun, Mars conjunct its ASC, Jupiter trine its MC, Uranus trine its Saturn, Saturn trine its Mercury and Mars trine its Mercury. Ukraine has Pluto conjunct its Saturn, Saturn square its Uranus, Neptune sextile its Saturn, Sun sextile its Jupiter and Sun sextile its Mercury.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while Mars trines the ASC and the Sun squares natal Mercury. These contacts coincide with reports on US sanctions pauses and Starlink access questions. The new moon in the 11th house places emphasis on the legislature and allies.

Neptune squares the natal Sun, Mars conjoins the ASC and Uranus trines natal Saturn. These sit alongside mentions of air-raid activity and personnel-loss claims. The new moon falls in the 6th house, the sector of armed forces and public health.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Saturn squares natal Uranus. Venus square Pluto overlaps with reports of a warehouse fire in Lviv attributed to drone activity. The new moon in the 6th house again highlights armed forces and workers.

Pluto opposes natal Moon and Saturn opposes natal Neptune. These contacts align with notes on rocket or missile alerts. The new moon in the 6th house places focus on the armed forces and public health.

reading.lore_and_intel: Neptune sextile Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto overlap with reporting on European protests and Middle East tanker effects, while Venus square Pluto meets the Lviv warehouse fire account and Mars trine Saturn meets notes on air-raid volume and potential strikes. Saturn conjunct Neptune touches Israel alert mentions. No overlap appears with the Sun sextile Jupiter or Mercury square Jupiter items on Medicaid or Starlink reliance, and several listed transits lack corresponding intel entries.
reading.the_test: Records show Mars afflicted versus Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israel alerts and Russian losses performed no better than chance. Full moons versus the same alert series and eclipses or new and full moons versus magnitude 6+ earthquakes likewise showed no predictive edge over the tested periods.
